citations.text: The data were analyzed by Chi-square test, Fisher's exact test, and independent t-test for demographic and clinical differences between two groups. We used Cochran test (for variables such as suicidal thoughts, plans and planning to commit suicide, recurrent suicidal attempts) and repeated measure (ANOVA) (for variables such as hope and desire and motivation to life).
The study followed the Declaration of Helsinki on Biomedical Research Involving Human Subjects and was approved by the Ethics Committee from the Isfahan University of Medical Sciences (No.: 392367.).
